question: 活動量切れの残りHPを、現地に落とす装甲パーツへどう換算するか
evidence: game/outcome.ts: return wear is flat returnKind wear, downed durability is zero, no HP ratio conversion
trade/hangar.ts repairCost: missing durability armor, not combat HP
World.deployedDurability stores starting current durability; saved durabilityMax exists on OwnedMech
Unit.maxHp includes circuit adjustments and differs from saved durabilityMax

C.rule: 神宮が別の換算式と端数処理を指定

answer.rule: 残HPと等価。保存耐久や最大HP比へ換算しない。装甲パーツの整数化は既存compactYieldBagを使用。

legacy: 既存残骸の資源を消去/返却する移行を追加しない
